title: Run agents on local GPU models via a managed Ollama sidecar
body:
## Summary

Add first-class **local model** support to Panopticon, targeting the **Pi harness** for the first release. Flagship model: **Gemma 4 12B** (encoder-free unified multimodal, Apache-2.0). Backend: a managed **Ollama** sidecar so `pan install` / `pan sync` / `pan up` give users a smooth path to running agents against a model on their own GPU — zero marginal cost, fully private.

The Ollama provider should be **model-agnostic** (the model name is just a string, like our existing OpenRouter provider) so any local Ollama tag works; **Gemma 4 12B is the documented default** we pull.

> **Scope decision:** v1 = **Pi harness only**, **Options 1 + 2** below. Extending local Ollama to the **Codex** and **Claude Code** harnesses plus a dashboard model picker is tracked separately in the follow-up issue (see "Follow-up" at the bottom). Gemma 3 is **not** in scope — Gemma 4 supersedes it. DeepSeek V4 is out of scope (route via OpenRouter for now).

## Why Gemma 4 12B

- First mid-size Gemma to **ditch separate multimodal encoders entirely** — projects raw image patches / audio waveforms straight into the embedding space instead of bolting on a ~550M SigLIP vision tower + audio encoder. ([blog.google](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/introducing-gemma-4-12b/), [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48385906))
- Google: **beats the older Gemma 3 27B** on GPQA Diamond / MMLU-Pro, nearly matches a 26B, runs in ~16 GB, native function-calling.
- Apache-2.0, native text/image/audio/video.
- Footprint ~8 GB at Q4 — trivially fits the owner's 24 GB machines.

## Why Ollama as the sidecar

Cross-platform single backend covering both owner machines — **RTX 3090 Ti (24 GB, Linux/CUDA)** and **Apple M4 (24 GB unified, Metal/MLX under the hood)**:
- Auto GPU/Metal offload, `ollama pull <model>`, `ollama serve`, OpenAI-compatible `/v1` endpoint.
- Google ships QAT Gemma builds for Ollama directly.

Alternatives considered and rejected for this goal: **LM Studio** (GUI, not headless-scriptable), **llama.cpp** (manual GGUF management), **vLLM** (CUDA-only, won't run on M4, overkill for single-user), **mlx-lm** (Mac-only → forces a per-platform backend). Ollama is the best single-backend fit. ([Apple Silicon comparative study](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2511.05502))

> ⚠️ **Integration nuance:** Ollama exposes an **OpenAI-compatible** `/v1` endpoint, **not** Anthropic-compatible. **Pi speaks OpenAI-compatible natively**, so wire it to `http://localhost:11434/v1` directly — do NOT route Ollama through `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`. (Claude Code's Anthropic-only requirement is why it's deferred to the follow-up issue, where we generalize `openai-compatible-proxy.ts` as the shim.)

## Scope for v1: Options 1 + 2

**Option 1 — Provider registry + config (minimal):**
- Add an `ollama` entry to the provider registry (`src/lib/providers.ts`), model-agnostic like OpenRouter; map model→provider in `getProviderForModelSync`.
- Reuse the localhost validation already in `src/lib/conversations/embeddings/providers.ts` (`SAFE_OLLAMA_HOST_RE`, `OLLAMA_BASE_URL`, default `http://localhost:11434`).
- Optional `providers.ollama.base_url` in `~/.panopticon/config.yaml`; workhorse/role model refs already resolve arbitrary strings.
- Verify harness-policy allows `pi` + ollama (expected yes — non-Anthropic; `src/lib/harness-policy.ts`).
- Wire Pi's OpenAI-compatible base URL in the launcher (`src/lib/runtimes/pi.ts`).

**Option 2 — Managed sidecar (the "smooth" UX):**
- `pan install`: detect Ollama (`ollama --version` / `GET /api/tags`); if missing, guide install (`curl … | sh` on Linux, brew/dmg on Mac) behind a `--skip-ollama` flag — mirror the Moonshine/CLIProxy patterns (`src/cli/commands/install.ts`).
- Offer to `ollama pull` the default Gemma 4 12B tag.
- `pan up`: lazy-ensure `ollama serve` is running (mirror CLIProxy's `ensureOpenAICompatibleProxyRunning` lifecycle in `src/lib/cliproxy.ts`).
- Pre-spawn health check: endpoint reachable + model present; clear, actionable error if not.

## Hardware fit (owner machines)

- **RTX 3090 Ti, 24 GB:** Gemma 4 12B (~8 GB Q4) with huge headroom. Best local-agent box.
- **Apple M4, 24 GB unified:** Gemma 4 12B comfortable (leaves room for OS); Ollama uses Metal automatically. ([Mac perf](https://medium.com/google-cloud/gemma-3-performance-tokens-per-second-in-lm-studio-vs-ollama-mac-studio-m3-ultra-7e1af75438e4))

## Key integration points (from codebase recon)

- `src/lib/providers.ts` — add `ollama` provider, model→provider mapping, dynamic model list.
- `src/lib/runtimes/pi.ts` — wire OpenAI-compatible base URL (`/v1`) into Pi's launcher env.
- `src/lib/harness-policy.ts` — verify `pi` + ollama allowed.
- `src/lib/config-yaml.ts` — optional `providers.ollama.base_url`.
- `src/cli/commands/install.ts` — Ollama detect/guide step (`--skip-ollama`) + optional model pull.
- `src/lib/cliproxy.ts` — reference pattern for lazy sidecar lifecycle / health check.
- Reuse: `src/lib/conversations/embeddings/providers.ts` (Ollama URL validation).

## Acceptance criteria (v1 = Options 1 + 2)

- [ ] `ollama` provider registered, model-agnostic, OpenAI-compatible endpoint; default model Gemma 4 12B.
- [ ] A **Pi** work agent runs end-to-end against local Gemma 4 12B with **zero cloud calls**.
- [ ] `pan install` detects/guides Ollama setup and can pull the default Gemma tag (`--skip-ollama` to opt out).
- [ ] `pan up` ensures the Ollama endpoint is live; pre-spawn health check with a clear error.
- [ ] Docs: install → pull → configure `~/.panopticon/config.yaml` → run a Pi agent locally, for both Linux/CUDA and Apple Silicon.

## Follow-up (separate issue)

Extending local Ollama to **all harnesses** + dashboard UX:
- **Codex** harness → native `--oss` flag (Codex is already integrated; `{claude-code, pi, codex}`).
- **Claude Code** harness → generalize `src/lib/openai-compatible-proxy.ts` (currently hardcoded to `nous`/`dashscope`) to accept a localhost Ollama upstream, exposing an Anthropic-compatible endpoint via `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`.
- **Dashboard** model picker listing local Ollama tags (`/api/tags`) per role / for conversations; `settings-api.ts` provider toggle + base URL; per-role harness+model override.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
